Greeting every one 

I need to compute composite reliability based on Jöreskog (1971). i know that maximalRelia function in semTools compute some kind of composite reliability. but i do not  know:
1) how it determine weights for items? 
 
2) how we can compute composite reliability based on weighted items, unweighted items and unit weights for all items.

Best

Thanks, i find solution to my question. hear is an example from lavaan to show how maximalRelia computes item weights.


require(lavaan)
require(semTools)
total <- 'f =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 '
fit <- cfa(total, data = HolzingerSwineford1939,std.lv = TRUE)
summary(fit)
lambda <- inspect(fit,"est")$lambda
lambda
theta <- round(diag(inspect(fit,what = "est")$theta),3)
theta
myweigths <- as.vector(lambda/theta) 
myweigths
maximalRelia(fit)
# Extract the weight
mr <- maximalRelia(fit)
maximalRelia.weigths <- attr(mr, "weight")
maximalRelia.weigths

# item weights computed manully. compare them with item weights from maximalRelia()
 round(cbind(maximalRelia.weigths,myweigths),3)
   maximalRelia.weigths myweigths
x1                0.466     0.465
x2                0.197     0.197
x3                0.208     0.208
x4                2.597     2.593
x5                2.236     2.230
x6                2.579     2.575
x7                0.172     0.171
x8                0.208     0.207
x9                0.337     0.336

# compare weighted reliability computed manully with  weighted reliability from maximalRelia()
round(cbind(sum(lambda^2/theta)/(1+sum(lambda^2/theta)),maximalRelia(fit)[1]),3)
      [,1]  [,2]
[1,] 0.887 0.887
